title: fix(runtime): the sandbox relay keeps the engine's DuplicateRecordError, so a script body's uncaught duplicate answers 409 UNIQUE_VIOLATION (#23702)
body:
Fixes #23702
Clause-②: no

## What changed

A `type: 'script'` action body (or a sandboxed hook body) that lets the engine's `DuplicateRecordError` leave unchanged now reaches every door as the engine's own error, so the action door answers the ruled `409 UNIQUE_VIOLATION`. A body that throws `DUPLICATE_RECORD` itself keeps it.

One upstream place, the sandbox relay in `packages/runtime/src/sandbox/quickjs-runner.ts`. No door changed. The shared key `isEngineDuplicateRecordEnvelope` (`@objectstack/types`) is **not** changed. `packages/mcp`, the dispatcher's `errorFromThrown` and `metadata-protocol` are untouched.

- `hostErrorToVm` now remembers each engine refusal it marshals into the VM. It holds a dup of the VM error handle, the host-side error, and a snapshot of everything that crosses back out of the VM (`name`, `message`, `code`, `fields`, `status`, `userMessage`). It holds only what the shared predicate calls the engine's envelope, asked on the HOST-side error.
- The L2 wrapper's completion value is now the body's own promise (`SETTLE`), with the same two handlers attached and the body source still on line 2. The host holds that promise.
- When `__error` is set, the pump loop reads the body promise's rejection reason (`getPromiseState`). If it is `vm.eq` to a held refusal and its snapshot is unchanged, the runner throws the host's `DuplicateRecordError` itself. Otherwise it relays as before. Every handle is released before `vm.dispose()`.

Why identity, not text: the flattened `NAME: MESSAGE` string and every field are writable by a body (`e.name = 'DuplicateRecordError'` included). The VM object a host call rejected with is something only the host hands out. No global a body can write is consulted.

## Where the line falls (hypothesis a)

| what the body throws | treated as | why |
|---|---|---|
| uncaught engine refusal | the engine's | the object the host handed in, unchanged |
| `catch (e) { throw e }` | the engine's | the same object in the same state. It cannot be told apart from uncaught by any relay |
| caught, held across another host call, thrown later | the engine's | the same object, unchanged |
| the engine's object with `name`/`message`/`code`/`status`/`fields`/`userMessage` rewritten, then thrown | a speaker | the "re-thrown unchanged" line the nested-refusal relay (`SANDBOX_REFUSAL_OF_PROP`) already draws in this file |
| its own `Error` carrying the code, any `name` (a forged `DuplicateRecordError` included), or a copy of the engine's fields | a speaker | a different object |

## Before / after, measured

Rig: #23686's, i.e. better-sqlite3 `:memory:` under the real `ObjectQL`, bodies bound through `actionBodyRunnerFactory` / `hookBodyRunnerFactory` over a real `QuickJSScriptRunner`, and `HttpDispatcher.dispatch()` over a real Fetch `Request`. "Before" was read at base `69351e985`, "after" at `72bc1ba45` (the runner commit) and pinned at the final head.

| producer shape | door | before | after |
|---|---|---|---|
| script body, uncaught insert repeating a unique value | `POST /api/v1/actions/udoc/:action` | `409 DUPLICATE_RECORD`, message `DuplicateRecordError: Duplicate record refused on 'udoc': …`, no `details` | `409 UNIQUE_VIOLATION`, message `Duplicate record refused on 'udoc': …`, `details` = `developerMessage` + `object: udoc` |
| script body, `catch (e) { throw e }` | same | `409 DUPLICATE_RECORD` (as above) | `409 UNIQUE_VIOLATION` (as above) |
| script body, caught, held, thrown later | same | `409 DUPLICATE_RECORD` | `409 UNIQUE_VIOLATION` |
| host handler whose write fires a sandboxed `beforeInsert` hook body that lets its refusal leave | same | `409 DUPLICATE_RECORD`, `DuplicateRecordError: …` | `409 UNIQUE_VIOLATION`, `object: udoc` |
| script body whose write fires that sandboxed hook (two VM hops) | same | `409 DUPLICATE_RECORD` (ablation leg) | `409 UNIQUE_VIOLATION` |
| `engine.insert('hdoc')` refused by that hook body, classified by `mapDataError` (the `/data` classification, read at function level) | REST classification | `409 DUPLICATE_RECORD`, `object: hdoc` | `409 UNIQUE_VIOLATION`, curated sentence, `developerMessage`, `object: udoc` |
| CONTROL: `throw Object.assign(new Error('That address is already on file'), { code: 'DUPLICATE_RECORD', status: 409 })` | action door | `409 DUPLICATE_RECORD`, its own sentence | unchanged |
| CONTROL: own `Error` named `DuplicateRecordError` carrying the code | action door | `409 DUPLICATE_RECORD` | unchanged |
| CONTROL: engine's object with `message` rewritten | action door | `409 DUPLICATE_RECORD`, `DuplicateRecordError: That address is already on file` | unchanged |
| CONTROL: engine's object with `userMessage` added | action door | `409 DUPLICATE_RECORD` | unchanged |
| CONTROL: own `Error` copying the engine's message, code and status | action door | `409 DUPLICATE_RECORD` | unchanged |
| CONTROL: hook body speaking the code | REST classification | `409 DUPLICATE_RECORD`, own sentence, `object: hdoc2` | unchanged |

Hypothesis (b) holds: the `DuplicateRecordError: ` class-name prefix is gone from `message` in the translated case. The door renders the engine's own `message`, and `details.developerMessage` carries the same sentence.

Hypothesis (c):
- Sandboxed hook bodies cross the same relay: measured and pinned at the action door, once behind a host handler and once behind a script body (two VM hops).
- The `/data` classification also answers the hooked refusal as `UNIQUE_VIOLATION` after this. That was measured at function level (`mapDataError`), not through a booted `RestServer`, and is not pinned as a door.
- Flow `script` nodes do not cross this relay: the node calls a registered host function (`config.function`), and no `service-automation` source constructs a `QuickJSScriptRunner`. This is by reading.
- Job bodies run in the same runner (the relay is origin-agnostic: the unit pin covers the `hook` origin) and have no HTTP door.

## Tests

- `packages/runtime/src/sandbox/engine-refusal-relay.test.ts` (new, 11): identity with `toBe` for uncaught, re-thrown, held-then-thrown and hook origin; speaker controls (deliberate throw, forged name, copied fields, rewritten `message`, rewritten `userMessage`, and a body that writes `__error` itself while its promise fulfils); an unrelated host refusal (`RECORD_NOT_FOUND`, 404) still crosses as a `SandboxError`.
- `packages/runtime/src/sandbox-relay-unique-violation-wire-code.test.ts` (new, 6): the door rows above, codes and key presence asserted, never wording.
- Ablation 1, through `node scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` (wrap mode) under an outer `trap … EXIT INT TERM` restore on the absolute path. The anchor `if (engineRefusal !== undefined) throw engineRefusal;` was replaced by a no-op marker: anchor 1 to 0, blob `b9f665347f4e` to `39c74645fd41`. Result `Tests 8 failed | 9 passed (17)`: exactly the 8 positive rows red (4 door rows `expected 'DUPLICATE_RECORD' to be 'UNIQUE_VIOLATION'`, 4 unit rows received `SandboxError`), every control green. Restore: blob == HEAD `b9f665347f4e`, `git diff HEAD` empty. The pins import the runner from `src` by relative path, so no build sits in the resolution path.
- Ablation 2, same tool: the unchanged-snapshot half of the match removed. Result `Tests 2 failed | 9 passed (11)`: exactly the rewritten-`message` and rewritten-`userMessage` controls red. Restore proven the same way.

At the final head `edf7ad877` (origin/main `8c85141c5` merged):
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/runtime test`: `Test Files 392 passed (392)`, `Tests 5895 passed | 19 skipped (5914)`.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/runtime test:repo`: `Test Files 3 passed (3)`, `Tests 808 passed (808)`.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/runtime typecheck`: exit 0. `check:test-typecheck: OK`: 27 files / 190 errors / 68 pinned signatures held, no new debt, and both new test files are in that program (`--listFilesOnly`).
- The two new files plus four neighbouring pins by path (`dispatcher-unique-violation-wire-code`, `error-passthrough`, `nested-refusal-sentence-relay`, `capability-denial-is-a-fault`): `Test Files 6 passed (6)`, `Tests 57 passed (57)`.

## Gates

At `edf7ad877`, `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` derived 61 commands from 4 changed paths (merge base `8c85141c5`). All 61 ran, with exit codes captured before any pipe.
- 60 answered exit 0 on the first pass. `check:dual-build-cjs-loads` answered `PREREQUISITE NOT MET` (exit 3, no workspace `dist`); after the turbo build (75 tasks, 74 cached) it answered exit 0 (110 entry points across 68 packages load).
- `--ran`: `61 derived, 61 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN`, exit 0.

Lint: a narrowed run, the scoped form `eslint.config.mjs`'s own header prescribes.
- `node --stack-size=4000 node_modules/eslint/bin/eslint.js --no-inline-config packages/runtime` (the `pnpm lint` binary and flags): exit 0.
- `--format json` over the three changed `.ts` files: 3 files linted, 0 errors, 0 warnings. The changeset is ignored by the config, as under `pnpm lint`.
- Positive control: the same command reds on a restricted root `@objectstack/spec` import piped on stdin at a `packages/runtime` path (exit 1, `no-restricted-imports`).

CI's families are this PR's check-runs.

## Acceptance notes

- In-process: a caller of a write whose sandboxed hook body lets the refusal leave, or of a script action whose body does, now catches the engine's `DuplicateRecordError` rather than a `SandboxError`. `code` and `status` are unchanged; `innerMessage` and the `hook 'NAME' threw:` wrapper are gone. The changeset states it.
- MCP: `run_action` on a sandboxed body now hands `@objectstack/mcp` the engine's own class. MCP still relays `DUPLICATE_RECORD`; #23701 (the MCP twin, seat 1's) is not addressed here. A change there keyed on the shared predicate would cover the sandboxed case too (by reading).
- Docs: "the in-process spelling never crosses HTTP" now holds for the sandboxed relay. No docs edit.
- Observed while measuring, reported to the seat and not changed here: a body that throws a plain object answers with flattened text at the action door. `throw { code: 'EMAIL_TAKEN', message: '…' }` answers `400 VALIDATION_ERROR` with `undefined: …`, and `throw { code: 'DUPLICATE_RECORD' }` answers `400 DUPLICATE_RECORD` with `[object Object]`.
- origin/main moved after the merge (`cd86e41b0` touches `packages/runtime/src/app-plugin.ts`, outside this diff). It was not merged again: there is no conflict.
